Name of Institution: Council of Nigerian Mining Engineers and Geoscientists (COMEG)
Mandate: Statutory regulatory council mandated to accredit, certify and regulate the practice of mining engineering and geosciences in Nigeria.
Value Chain Role: Professional regulation, accreditation and competency assurance.
Summary Functions: Accredits academic programmes; licenses professionals; enforces competency and ethical standards; regulates geoscience and mining engineering practice.

Name of Institution: The Nigerian Institution of Metallurgical, Mining & Materials Engineers (NIMMME)
Mandate: Professional body promoting metallurgy, mining and materials engineering excellence.
Value Chain Role: Professional development, engineering standards and capacity building.
Summary Functions: Organises conferences; supports engineering innovation; sets technical standards; strengthens collaboration among materials, mining and metallurgy professionals.

Name of Institution: National Steel Raw Materials Exploration Agency (NSRMEA), Kaduna
Mandate: Federal agency mandated to explore, evaluate and develop steel raw materials including iron ore, limestone and kaolin.
Value Chain Role: Exploration, resource evaluation and mineral mapping.
Summary Functions: Conducts geological mapping; evaluates mineral occurrences; supports steel and industrial minerals development; provides mineral data to industry and government.

Mandate: National R&D centre supporting Nigeria’s metallurgical, minerals processing and materials science sector.
Value Chain Role: Mineral beneficiation, metallurgical research, pilot-scale mineral processing.
Summary Functions: Runs labs and pilot plants; conducts mineral processing studies; supports steel and alloy R&D; provides technical services and professional training.

Mandate: Technical vocational institute offering certified training in metallurgy, welding, industrial maintenance and mineral-related trades.
Value Chain Role: Technical manpower development and vocational training.
Summary Functions: Trains technicians for mining and metallurgy; offers accredited diplomas; provides workshops and industrial attachments; builds skilled workforce for mineral value chain.

Mandate: Professional society advancing geology education, research and responsible georesource development.
Value Chain Role: Geoscience knowledge development, research and training.
Summary Functions: Organises conferences; publishes geological research; supports field training; promotes responsible geoscience and mineral development.

Mandate: Private-sector think tank influencing national economic and mineral-sector policy.
Value Chain Role: Policy advocacy, investment climate reform and economic strategy.
Summary Functions: Conducts research; engages government on mining sector reforms; convenes national dialogues; promotes private-sector competitiveness.

Name of Institution: Nigerian Institute of Mining and Geosciences (NIMG)
Mandate: Federal postgraduate institution training professionals in mining engineering, geosciences and mineral management.
Value Chain Role: Applied research, specialised training and capacity building.
Summary Functions: Provides postgraduate training; conducts applied research; strengthens Nigeria’s mining technical capacity; supports mineral development policy.
